items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And that's when we got -- for a while we had Porter Kilbert for a while and got Hilton Jefferson.

ctx.x: That's right. That's when he left the band. We sent and got Dave Black. But we lost Willie Smith out in California. He left the band. He went to join Billy May. And that's when we got -- for a while we had Porter Kilbert for a while and got Hilton Jefferson.
